about.title: About me
about.p1: Mechanical R&D engineer specializing in precision mechanical design, experimental prototyping and scientific instrumentation. I work with CAD-based mechanical development, additive manufacturing, FEA/CFD and hands-on fabrication, with a strong focus on rapid prototyping, experimental testing and iterative design optimization.
about.p2: I develop and validate mechanical and electromechanical systems, integrate sensors and hardware, and translate engineering concepts into functional laboratory prototypes. Alongside my work I build my own hardware and software projects, from embedded sensors to Android apps and VR simulations.

bullets: Co-authored technical manuscripts by developing experimental test setups, conducting laboratory investigations and acquiring reliable empirical data.
Characterized mechanical behavior and structural performance through iterative experimental testing and Finite Element Method (FEM) simulations.
Designed precision mechanical housings for optical gyroscope systems using CATIA, integrating optical components with mechanically stable and manufacturable structures.
Generated manufacturing-ready technical drawings applying Geometric Dimensioning and Tolerancing (GD&T) principles to ensure dimensional accuracy and functional interfaces.
Managed external fabrication workflows including CNC machining and additive manufacturing, and validated manufactured components through dimensional metrology and inspection.

items.org: Institut für Prototypen und Modelltechnik (IPM), Germany
bullets: Investigated critical FDM process parameters in novel needle-insertion 3D printing to improve inter-layer adhesion, dimensional consistency and structural performance.
Conducted tensile and strain analyses of engineering polymers, combining experimental characterization with quantitative data analysis to evaluate mechanical performance.

items.org: Institut für Prototypen und Modelltechnik (IPM), Germany
bullets: Optimized extrusion mechanics and hot-end thermal stability of the Mycusini 1.0 system through mechanical development, experimental testing and iterative prototype refinement.
Refined system firmware and integrated electromechanical test feedback to improve motion control, thermal performance and overall system reliability.

items.org: Institut für Prototypen und Modelltechnik (IPM), Germany
bullets: Prototyped an experimental FDM 3D printer system, performing mechanical assembly, hardware integration and custom firmware configuration.
Conducted statistical analysis of material strain data to experimentally validate the mechanical performance and repeatability of a newly developed needle-insertion nozzle.

Designed, manufactured and implemented a satellite transportation container for the safe transportation of satellites, with full responsibility for mechanical design, structural architecture, fabrication and integration of mechanical and electronic subsystems.

Designed and fabricated passive Wire Rope Isolators (WRI) according to specified performance requirements and MIL-STD-810 vibration and shock requirements; experimentally characterized their shock-isolation performance using a magnetic shock testing system.

Designed and built a 2-DOF helicopter test unit for experimental investigation of yaw and pitch dynamics, including mechanical design, actuation, instrumentation and electromechanical system integration.
Designed and fabricated an aerodynamic propeller test unit for experimental evaluation of thrust force and aerodynamic performance.

Performed 3D CAD design, precision mechanical fabrication, electromechanical integration, rapid prototyping and experimental validation of specialized engineering systems in accordance with applicable MIL and industry standards.
Designed and integrated a prototype hybrid solar–wind power generation system, covering mechanical structure, component integration and electromechanical subsystem development.
Assembled and calibrated custom high-precision FDM 3D printers, optimizing mechanical hardware, structural alignment and multi-axis motion performance.
Programmed and debugged open-source Marlin firmware to improve multi-axis motion control, thermal management and system reliability.
